method: For each candidate positive pixel, compute Euclidean distance in pixels to nearest positive lattice pixel; report fraction <= 3 px. Hard cells are candidate values >0.5; all positive cells are >0.

result.reason: This one witness check is not a complete registry audit. The registry and official footprint are absent; pre-placement surface rank correlation was not computed. The raster itself uses synthetic fields and footprint.
result.spearman_scope: All finite raster cells sampled; not a pre-placement surface comparison over the official active footprint.

blob_dot_overlap.definition: 8-connected value==1 components represented by rounded centroid; unsuitable for line-like merged blobs, shown alongside all-pixel measure.

holdout.reason: Competition training features and labels are absent.

verdict: negative; archive only; do not submit
